messages.subject: WITHOUT PREJUDICE — Gareth Hollis / Caspian Technologies
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Ashworth,

Without prejudice and subject to contract. Please find our letter setting out proposed settlement terms for your client, together with a first draft of the settlement agreement. In summary: six months' PILON (£95,000), statutory redundancy (£8,400), an ex gratia payment of £75,000, the unpaid pro-rated bonus (£14,250), a costs contribution and an agreed reference, with the non-compete reduced to six months. The offer is open until 5pm on 17 December.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Sarah Whitfield

Sarah Whitfield
Partner, Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: WITHOUT PREJUDICE — Gareth Hollis / Caspian Technologies
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Whitfield,

Thank you. We have taken our client's instructions. The structure is broadly acceptable but the ex gratia figure is light given the protected-disclosure exposure — our client's schedule of loss pleads close to £197,000. We will return a marked-up draft shortly. Our client also expects a fuller contribution to his legal costs and confirmation that his vested options are preserved.

Regards,
Marcus Ashworth
Ashworth Quinn LLP
